candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow downstream, propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not admitted; exact payment slowness cause unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated ReadTimeout on POST payment from order, yielding 502 at /v1/orders and /v1/checkout; gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment. Bounded to downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics to confirm payment is the slow dependency
Payment service logs or traces showing why /v1/authorizations exceeds the read timeout
